description.text: Pre-university program comprises two semesters (September-next July). After completing the program, students enrolled in the preuniversity program who get good grades and successfully pass the college entrance examination will be admitted to the undergraduate programs. Those who cannot meet the college entrance requirement can obtain their final grades and program certificate from the university. Application Schedule March 20 -April 20

duration.text: The Pre-university Program at Renmin University of China is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2986 USD/In total ￥ 21500 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). 7. Photocopy of valid Visa or Residence Permit For the applicants who are already in China

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport and above the age of 18 2. Senior high school graduate with an average grade of B or higher 3. HSK level 5(or above)
